title: Cash Flow Rush

selected_categories.reasoning: The game is an endless score-attack session with increasing speed and pressure, continuing until failure rather than through discrete levels.
The player has limited lives, must avoid hazards, and survives as long as possible while difficulty escalates.
It loosely resembles a lane-based catcher because the player reacts to descending threats and rewards, but actual movement is freeform rather than locked to lanes.
The theme and constant score accumulation are money-focused, but the play is reflex-driven movement rather than tapping for currency generation.
Pickup particles, floating numbers, polished UI, and tactile feedback create a mild satisfaction-game layer, though it is secondary to arcade survival.
